_comment: The zones config for `--classifier station` at hala prawe skrzydlo (#123).
The polygon IS the station rectangle, in native 3840x2160 pixels, and it has
to equal the card's `station.zone_native_px` exactly — the run refuses
otherwise, because a head fed a rectangle it was not fitted on still returns
confident logits and nothing downstream would say so.
y is 1360, not the 1400 the manifest originally recorded. `crop=900:800:1700:1400`
does not fit a 2160-tall frame, and ffmpeg's crop filter slides the rectangle
back inside rather than failing, so every training crop was cut at in_h - h.
`classifier` is the per-camera setting the REST entrypoint resolves at
container start, the same way it resolves `pose.mode`. No pose model, OSNet
or VLM is constructed in this mode, so nothing here configures one.
